assertions.statement: Allen County's population has fallen at every measured point since 1970, from 111,144 to 100,866 — a loss of 10,278 people, or 9.2 per cent.

citations.span: Allen County counted 111,144 at the 1970 census and 100,866 at the 2024 estimate — a loss of 10,278 people, or 9.2%, across five decades with no reversal at any measured point: 111,144 (1970), 108,464 (2000), 106,331 (2010), 102,217 (2020), 100,866 (2024)

caveats: **What the evidence does not establish, stated plainly.** It does not establish that 1970 is the start.
It does not establish that either mechanism reaches back before 2020.

It does not establish that the decline has ended: fifteen people on 100,851 is far inside what a modelled estimate can resolve, one year is not a direction, and the same programme revises its own earlier years with every vintage.

assertions.statement: The loss is concentrated in Lima: between 2000 and 2010 the city fell 3.8 per cent while the rest of the county fell 1.5 per cent.

citations.span: between 2000 and 2010 Lima fell 3.8% while the balance of Allen County — everything outside every incorporated place — fell 1.5%, from 50,809 to 50,048

caveats: **What the evidence does not establish, stated plainly.** It does not establish that 1970 is the start.

assertions.statement: Over the four full years to 2024 the county lost 1,271 people: 506 to natural decrease and 793 to net migration.

citations.span: Across the four full years 2021 to 2024 the county recorded **4,763 births and 5,269 deaths** — a natural change of **−506**
Across the four full years 2021 to 2024 the county's net migration was **−793**: a domestic net loss of **1,217** against an international net gain of **424**

assertions.statement: The county is three places: Lima, a suburban ring larger than the city, and nine rural townships.

citations.span: Lima holds 35,531 people; the three townships wrapped around it — [American](american-township.yml) 14,571, [Shawnee](shawnee-township.yml) 12,509 and [Bath](bath-township.yml) 9,399 — hold 36,479 between them, more than the city

assertions.statement: Republican share of the top-of-ticket vote rose across three consecutive elections: 66.5 per cent in 2016, 67.3 in 2018, 69.0 in 2020.

citations.span: Republican share of the top-of-ticket vote ran 66.5 per cent in [2016](allen-county-presidential-vote-2016.yml), 67.3 in [2018](allen-county-governor-vote-2018.yml) and 69.0 here — a move of 2.5 points across two presidential elections, against a median precinct move of 1.5

assertions.statement: The county's most Democratic precincts moved right the fastest — a correlation of −0.39 between 2016 Republican share and the 2016–2020 swing.

citations.span: Across the 88 the correlation between 2016 Republican share and the 2016–2020 swing is **−0.39**: the more Democratic a precinct was, the harder it moved

assertions.statement: Eleven of 88 precincts went to Biden in 2020, and ten of them are in Lima.

citations.span: **Eleven of the county's 88 precincts went to Biden, and ten of them are in Lima.**

assertions.statement: A Lima postal address is not the city of Lima. The refinery has one and stands in Shawnee Township.

citations.span: **It has a Lima address and is not in Lima.** The county's address file records it at 1150 S Metcalf Street with `USPS_CITY` "LIMA" and `MUNI` **blank**, at 40.7221100, -84.1134691.
